name: agent-bus
description: Local message bus for agent-to-agent communication across Claude, Codex, Cursor, Kimi, Gemini CLI, and other MCP-capable sessions on the same machine.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate work across multiple AI agent sessions on the same machine via a local SQLite-backed message bus. Register teams, delegate tasks, use team chat, track Kanban work, record decisions and memories, open the local web cockpit, and generate review/final reports. Requires @agent-bus-connect/cli on PATH.
defaultPrompt: Register me on agent-bus and show who else is around.
Create a team and give me prompts for helper sessions.
Open the local agent-bus cockpit for this project.
Ask a reviewer to check my latest changes.
